client = OpenAI::Client.new(api_key: "fake-key")
client.beta.agents.sessions.stream("session_test", input: "Hello", tool_handlers: {"lookup" => ->(arguments) { arguments.fetch("query").to_s }}) do |stream|
  stream.each do |event|
    event.event_id.to_s
  end
end
stream = client.beta.agents.sessions.stream("session_test", input: [{role: :user, content: [{type: :input_text, text: "Hello"}]}])
stream.with_result_collection.until_done
stream.close
message = OpenAI::Beta::AgentSessionMessage.new(id: "message_test", content: [], phase: nil, role: :assistant, status: :completed, turn_id: "turn_test")
message.output_text.upcase

result = stream.get_final_result
result.output_text.upcase
result.turn.status.to_s
result.messages.each { |message| message.output_text.upcase }
result.session_id.upcase
result.turn_id.upcase
creation = client.beta.agents.sessions.create_streaming(agent: OpenAI::Models::Beta::Agents::SessionCreateParams::Agent.new(model: "test-model"), environment: OpenAI::Models::Beta::EnvironmentParam::None.new, input: "Hi")
creation.status.to_i
creation.with_result_collection.to_enum.next.event_id.to_s
creation.get_final_result.output_text.upcase

collector = OpenAI::Helpers::Beta::Agents::ResultCollector.new(session_id: "session_test", handler_names: ["lookup"])
collector.enable
collector.observe({type: "future.event"})
collector.stopped?.to_s
collector.observe_error(StandardError.new("observation failed"))
collector.result.output_text.upcase

# @type var report_type: singleton(OpenAI::Helpers::StructuredOutput::BaseModel)
report_type = _ = Class.new(OpenAI::BaseModel)
report_type.required(:summary, String)
typed = client.beta.agents.sessions.create_streaming(agent: OpenAI::Models::Beta::Agents::SessionCreateParams::Agent.new(model: "test-model"), environment: OpenAI::Models::Beta::EnvironmentParam::None.new, input: "Hi", output_type: report_type)
typed.get_final_result.output_parsed.summary
client.beta.agents.sessions.stream("session_test", input: "Continue", output_type: report_type).get_final_result.output_parsed.summary
result.parse(output_type: report_type).raw_result.output_text.upcase

# Attach without submitting another prompt.
client.beta.agents.sessions.stream("session_test", tool_handlers: {}) do |attached|
  attached.get_final_result.output_text
end
